why: The 2025 AMT Challenge graded every entrant against MT3 (F1 0.3932) and `docs/model-discovery/README.md` lists MT3 in the provider catalogue as never having run on this infrastructure. This image exists to give MT3 a number on OUR benchmark instead of quoting theirs.
notOurIncumbent: MT3 is not what this platform runs. Basic Pitch is (services/transcription-baseline-worker). MT3 is the baseline the field compares to.

code.why: MR-MT3's repository vendors the MT3 inference stack (contrib/{spectrograms,vocabularies,note_sequences,event_codec,run_length_encoding}.py, a PyTorch T5) AND ships the ported MT3 weights, so one image can run both the MT3 baseline and MR-MT3 itself. Its `use_tf_spectral_ops=False` path uses a torchaudio mel spectrogram, which is why it is preferred over kunato/mt3-pytorch.
code.licenceNoteOnAlternatives: The challenge's own linked PyTorch baseline (github.com/ojas-chaturvedi/mt3-pytorch, a fork of kunato/mt3-pytorch) carries NO licence file at all — neither repository declares one. That is a real finding: the port the 2025 leaderboard was measured against is unlicensed. MR-MT3 is MIT and is used here instead.

MT3.note: the MT3 weights ported to PyTorch — the baseline

MR_MT3.note: MR-MT3 trained on Slakh; the repository's name for it records the Slakh F1 the authors measured, which is THEIR number on THEIR benchmark and is not used here for anything

model.architecture: T5 encoder-decoder over a log-mel spectrogram (16 kHz, hop 128, 512 mel bins); MT3 event vocabulary over 128 GM programs plus drums
model.inputFormat: mono 16 kHz audio, split into fixed frame batches
model.outputFormat: note_seq NoteSequence → notes with program and is_drum

runtime.note: MT3's inference stack is 2022-era: it imports `t5.data`, `seqio`, `ddsp` and `tensorflow` at module scope even on the PyTorch path. The whole TF dependency is pulled in for one integer (t5.data.DEFAULT_EXTRA_IDS) and one abstract base class (seqio.Vocabulary), but it is imported unconditionally, so the image installs it rather than patching upstream code. A patched image would produce a number for OUR FORK of MT3, not for MT3.

codeLicense.source: github.com/gudgud96/MR-MT3 LICENSE via the GitHub licence API

trainingData.stated: Slakh2100 (MT3 was trained on Slakh2100, MAESTRO, MusicNet, GuitarSet, URMP and Cerberus4 per the MT3 paper)
trainingData.underlyingWorksCleared: no — Slakh2100 is rendered from the Lakh MIDI dataset, which is web-scraped transcriptions of copyrighted recordings

licence.classification: RESEARCH_ONLY — a benchmark baseline. Never routed.
